title: Group Membership Event Type - Data API
description: Group Membership events capture details about changes to public group and queue membership, such as when members are added to or removed from the public group or queue.

CLIENT_IP.description: The IP address of the client that’s using Salesforce services.

CPU_TIME.description: The CPU time in milliseconds used to complete the request. This field indicates the amount of activity that took place in the app server layer.

EVENT_TYPE.description: The type of event. The value is always GroupMembership.

GROUP_ID.description: ID of the group whose membership changed.

GROUP_TYPE.description: The type of group. Valid values are: R—Public group Q—Queue

LOGIN_KEY.description: The string that ties together all events in a given user’s login session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout event or the user session expiring.

MEMBER_ID.description: The ID of the member added to or removed from the group. Public groups can contain individual users, other groups, or users in a specified role or territory. Queues can contain individual users, roles, public groups, territories, connections, or partner users.

OPERATION.description: The operation that occurred, such as a member being added to or removed from a group. Valid values are: AddedGroupMember DeletedGroupMember

REQUEST_ID.description: The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same REQUEST_ID.

RUN_TIME.description: The amount of time that the request took in milliseconds.

SESSION_KEY.description: The user’s unique session ID. You can use this value to identify all user events within a session. When a user logs out and logs in again, a new session is started.

TIMESTAMP.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT.

TIMESTAMP_DERIVED.description: The access time of Salesforce services in ISO8601-compatible format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ).

URI.description: The URI of the page that’s receiving the request.

URI_ID_DERIVED.description: The 18-character case insensitive ID of the URI of the page that’s receiving the request.

USER_ID.description: The 15-character ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API.

USER_ID_DERIVED.description: The 18-character case insensitive ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API.
